summary: Source-only consumer gap identified: the pinned original loader builds an addresses-only deserialized board, then instrumentedStore forwards it unchanged to the frozen store. Lab11 proves a synthetic adapter, Lab12/13 prove six isolated byte-sum leaves and lineage, but none proves wiring that adapter at this loader/profiler boundary or transporting a loader-produced structured Part. No execution occurred; a smallest fabricated seam/control proposal is prospective and repeats no new cache-mechanism claim.

findings.claim: Actual preserved consumer seam, not an invented loader-shaped abstraction
findings.evidence: source-evidence/s4-run.mjs lines 57-58 deserialize s3.pxc.bin entries into a Map, then return frozen {has,get,addresses} without keys(); lines 149-150 pass loaded.board as instrumentedStore base and add loaded.values as constant lane outputs. profile.mjs lines 23-25 forward base unchanged to createPartStore.
findings.qualification: The root-inventory source-identities manifest attributes this exact snapshot to ports/s4recover/run.mjs at platform ref 49255331791b1245cf0f9cd699816175f94e70f2. It is historical source evidence, not current original-owner execution or integration permission.

findings.claim: Exact fallback explains the known stale-key seam
findings.evidence: Frozen store.mjs lines 259-267 add provider roots only through b.keys(); line 415 adds rootsKey to any outPart-producing Calculation with nonempty calls. registerQueries lines 188-200 resolves string references through store.get without query inParts.
findings.qualification: Addresses alone are not enumerated by this store. Complete enumerableBoard makes those roots visible but retains broad invalidation; isolatedBatch obtains selective reuse by fresh single-root stores, not query dependency tracking.

findings.claim: Prior observed failures and controls already cover the enumeration mechanism
findings.evidence: Lab11 E4105 baseline.execution.json records one exit1 with Map 1->9->1 and loader stale1 on changed9, different source key but unchanged dependent key/hit and query0. R4105 accepts six synthetic adapter tests. Root-inventory README also records earlier synthetic byte-array false-reuse falsifiers, complete Map/keys working controls, and the warning that changed constants can incidentally separate courses.
findings.qualification: Do not rerun or rename these as a new RED, native defect, or novel cache repair.

findings.claim: Concrete missing consumer contract beyond scalar/six-sum tests
findings.evidence: enumerableBoard tests construct boards in memory; isolatedBatch accepts exactly six ordinary Uint8Array snapshots and emits scalar sums plus four-field lineage bridges. Lab13 adds same-answer permutation lineage only. None follows the loader's deserialize->addresses-only-board->instrumentedStore route with a fabricated structured provider Part plus unchanged constant lane outputs.
findings.qualification: That is a bounded integration/producer-shape gap, not evidence the adapter fails there. The six-Uint8Array recipe cannot simply receive loaded.board; no source here establishes a semantically correct native bridge or authoritative complete inventory.

prospective_smallest_probe.status: proposal only; no source written, imported or executed
prospective_smallest_probe.purpose: Verify a fabricated serialized-record producer reaches the exact existing profile/store seam with enumeration and Part content intact. Reuse the enumeration mechanism; do not market an additional algebra/property test as a new capability.
prospective_smallest_probe.producer: In a separate authorized scratch harness, create two tiny non-image Part entries and perform a node:v8 serialize/deserialize round trip. One is a structured packet {tag:'packet-A', payload:Uint8Array([1,2])}; the other is an unchanged declared no-calls control. Construct the exact preserved loader facade {has,get,addresses} over the resulting Map, without importing or invoking the original loader. Add one unchanged fabricated lane-output constant via store.constant, matching the consumer's boundary shape.
prospective_smallest_probe.consumer: Use existing instrumentedStore with one allowlisted synthetic unitful query reading only packet fields, and one outPart-producing synthetic caller declaring that query. Return a structured {tag, first} value rather than another sum or six-input aggregate. Keep functions, addresses, salt, constants and cache fixed across fresh immutable packet payload snapshots [1,2]->[9,2]->[1,2].
working_controls: Independent-cache complete Map arm using the same deserialized entries and instrumentedStore.
Independent-cache enumerableBoard(loaderFacade) arm using the same exact provider entries and instrumentedStore.
One explicitly declared no-calls fixed-Part control in each arm; leave lane-output constants identical so they cannot mask missing board-root keys.
prospective_smallest_probe.comparison_arm: Unwrapped addresses-only facade; prospective source prediction is stale packet first field on change, matching prior enumeration evidence. This is not a new observed failure.
prospective_smallest_probe.minimal_assertions: Compare structured result, provider content key, consumer key/cache flag and synthetic query call count across initial/change/restore; complete Map and wrapped facade must agree, restore must reuse. Check deserialized Part identity is forwarded by the wrapper and input bytes remain unchanged. No six-leaf locality or equal-answer permutation repetition is needed.
prospective_smallest_probe.exclusions: No real snapshot, original image/query/CV, recovery calculations, planner, browser, producer receipt invention, native integration, other-owner source adoption, root inventory authority claim, performance or production/default change. Fabricated completeness is supplied by the fixture, not inferred from keys().
